title: Kids Call Police On Their Mother After She Acts Like A Maniac
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On July 18th, 2023. Officers were dispatched to a residence regarding a mother who was high on drugs in her daughter’s home refusing to leave. When officers approached the woman, she was highly combative and refused to listen to officers after repeatedly being asked to leave. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
